page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-8-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance includes integrated local storage consisting of 805 GB of NVMe SSD capacity across two local drives. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance type.

The arm64 architecture offers a distinct hardware profile compared to traditional x86 platforms, focusing on resource density and power efficiency. With 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, the instance is structured for workloads requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute cores. The inclusion of 805 GB of local NVMe SSD storage provides high-speed local read and write capabilities directly attached to the instance, eliminating the latency of network-attached storage for temporary or caching workloads.

This instance configuration is designed for memory-intensive applications, local database caching, and containerized microservices that benefit from arm64 architecture. The combination of dedicated vCPUs, a 1:8 CPU-to-RAM ratio, and local NVMe SSD storage makes it suitable for relational databases, in-memory caches, and data processing tasks that require fast local scratch space.
